cooling_description: Developer states a closed-loop cooling system requiring 'only minimal water during normal operations'; initial system fill to be trucked to site rather than drawn from mains; Scottish Water reported to have confirmed supply capacity from Camphill Water Treatment Works.
notes: No quantified annual or peak water figures published; volumes should appear in the EIA. Scoping consultation response from Scottish Water is on the portal (doc 1333577) but has not been reviewed.
